title: Jobs for Antioch!
author: A O Muniz
tags: Speed-IF That Dare Not Speak Its Number
description: In this tiny game, you play as Bohemond, prince of Antioch. The principality has fallen upon hard times with the decline of the time tourism and liquid leather industries. You do have an awful lot of cows, though, and somehow, you'll use them to create new jobs for Antioch.
